salmon — provisioning, CI/CD and infrastructure operations as DAGs of idempotent operations, with up/down/check semantics and a long-running converge-and-supervise mode.

Overview: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/salmon/
Getting started: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/salmon/getting-started.html
The model (salmon-core): https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/salmon/docs-salmon-core.html
Writing and testing ops (cookbook): https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/salmon/docs-howto-ops.html
run serve, convergence and supervision: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/salmon/docs-serve-supervision.html
Builtins, recipes and binaries: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/salmon/builtins.html
Guides index: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/salmon/docs.html
Specs index (design sketches, each with a Status line): https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/salmon/specs.html
